There are a diverse selection of plasmas available. Each plasma has a unique set of inputs, outputs, ignition and heat values.

The ignition value corresponds to how much [[klystron|Klystron]] energy (KyU) is required to ignite that plasma. Output heat from each plasma may be chained using the [[fusion coupler|Fusion Reactor Coupler]] or used with a [[fusion boiler|Fusion Reactor Boiler]] or [[MHDT|MHD Turbine]] for power production.
